gloss: rock fishing; shore fishing from rocky coasts

definitions.gloss: rock fishing; shore fishing from rocky coasts
definitions.explanation: Recreational fishing done from rocky shorelines or coastal rocks, often targeting fish like {黒鯛|くろだい} or メジナ. A distinct style from boat fishing or pier fishing.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}と{磯釣|いそづ}りに{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went rock fishing with my father.

examples.japanese: {磯釣|いそづ}りには{滑|すべ}り{止|ど}め{付|つ}きの{靴|くつ}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: For rock fishing, non-slip shoes are essential.

examples.japanese: {波|なみ}の{高|たか}い{日|ひ}は{磯釣|いそづ}りは{危険|きけん}だから{中止|ちゅうし}した{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: On days with high waves, rock fishing is dangerous, so you should call it off.

notes:
Compound of {磯|いそ} (rocky shore) + {釣|つ}り (fishing), with rendaku (つり → づり). A serious hobby with its own gear and culture; considered one of the more rugged styles of recreational fishing due to the terrain and exposure to waves.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {磯釣|いそづ}りに{行|い}く: to go rock fishing
- {磯釣|いそづ}り{師|し}: a rock-fishing enthusiast
- {磯釣|いそづ}り{場|ば}: a rock-fishing spot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {船釣|ふなづ}り: boat fishing — from a boat at sea
- {投|な}げ{釣|づ}り: surf casting — long-distance casting from a beach
- {渓流釣|けいりゅうづ}り: mountain stream fishing — in rivers, not the sea
